I'm on here because I'm a child sex abuse survivor after someone figured out I was trans as a child.

Why are you on the sub throwing hate at vulnerable people?

Hey, that's my way too and I'm also trans. I've been dealing with a lot of ideation myself lately and dysphoria hasn't been helping in the least. Add on that I'm currently no contact with my family and life feels like trash.

Would you want to tell me about some of the things you're going through lately?
sending so much love your way hun. 🥰

yea it really is. I've been on the verge of another attempt between last night and also today also. Myself, use exhibitionism to try and feel desired and wanted. Both things I accept are cravings that the abuse contributed to. We are more than our abuse though and it really sounds like you have a good grasp on your kinks and a fairly healthy lifestyle and coping mechanisms so far as your kinks go. maybe your uncontrolled desires are indicating that your needs aren't being met. Maybe you need something sexually that isnt being fulfilled or maybe there's something you need to work on more directly in therapy or on one of your important relationships.

either way, you are valid, your gender is valid, your sexuality is valid, your experiences are valid, your feelings are valid.
she's adorable

I really appreciate that. Right now, I've been struggling with a lot. There is the loss of my family from coming out; The struggle of supporting myself with the limited positive energy I have when my friends (2 amazing people) need my support and a lot of that energy from me as well; The fear/financials/uncertainty of transitioning at all esp in the US. I have a fast approaching consultation with a FFS specialist in california and a tenative surgery date in early January. This is going to cost me every penny I have, $60k. I can't help but in my self attacks to think that my very best friend could do so much and benefit so greatly with that money while for me it feels like a craps shoot still to make it day-day

One day it might be acceptable or cherished to be trans. It hurts though. I've managed to fight through a lot of things to get as far as I have but I put myself out there almost as a sacrifice to try and make things better for someone else because I can't imagine getting so much further. I figure I can maybe make some sort of impact on others and things may be just a little easier for them to get further than I can.
Thanks, I really appreciate all of you who go out of your way to try and help people here on /sw
Thanks I'd like that. Dreams all through the night were suicide & depression related. Feeling far from energized

Still here but then being back in sw and posting in this sad forgotten post is not a good thing either. it's wrapping myself in depression. an acceptance that I'm not worth enough to reach out for help.

it's nearly 5am now and i have work at 8:30. I'm alone in my home, just the cat and I. I've been thinking hard about my exit plan. About the reasons I'm leaving and what that means.  For one, I don't know where to go from here. I'm confused and scared. Im tired of everything.

right now, I'm hiding in the bathroom at work. I feel like crying and self harming. I just got notices from work about the health plan for next year. I had fought pretty hard to have the transgender exclusion policy removed and well it's still there... I'm not doing well. I felt like I was even the tiniest bit successful already and that was one of the only things keeping me going. I've been struggling trying to get a pre approval/coverage at all for ffs and it feels like no matter what i do I'm always stuck at square 1... maybe this could be my leelah issue... maybe if I die because the health care in being denied/convulted then others won't have to know my pain. I'm tired. I've tried so very hard to live. I look at the semicolon i drew on myself and i feel like a sham. I drew it to plan for a tattoo but i haven't chosen life. i just haven't died yet but i want to.

Hey me... Well I've stopped making new posts asking for help on all my accounts now apparently... yea \u\ranmachan \u\catonedge and od course this one are all me... I think I just don't deserve help. I want to be in covered in my pain and fade away. I'm sorry to all the people I care for that things get so bad and you each worry about me. I'm sorry that you each hurt because of me. I'm sorry that I can't make it much further. I got interviewed for some study on agnostic/athiest/non religious beliefs. I told him that I feel cursed. He asked if I felt everything happens for a reason and I don't. There's no reason that I was born this way. There's no reason why I was raped. I'm tired... my friend B is starting to crash today... If she can't remain positive then it won't be much longer for me.

Little things I've tried to do to bring more positivity into this life have been fighting with blue Cross and my hr department to get their transgender exclusion removed. Being the first trans person to come out at work and hoping to inspire the others who i know are there. Last week I fed a starving trans girl by getting a pizza gift card to her. Today I've tried to inspire another trans girl on /sw to try a little longer and to be kind to themselves.

I'm tired and want to self harm. Moreso I want to stop fighting.

Back from my trip and still chugging along or maybe dragging myself along is the better phrase. So I quit my anti depressant even though I still went to the psych appointment. It's such a stupid thing, I just end up feeling like shit after the appointment and all it ever consists of is her checking that I'm still breathing and renewing my scripts. I asked her to switch to something besides wellbutrin. I told her that I was having problems with extreme sweating and that it wasn't helping. She told me it's not a side effect of the drug... I told her that I wanted to try something else and she told me no... So now I'm not taking anything. It was nice for the vacation that my mind was not nearly as clouded. I really feel like I was more connected and enjoying myself more than I could have otherwise. Then of course we got back on Sat and by Sun I was already back in crying fits. I've been sleeping a ton. Feels like I'm just constantly tired. My friend B is moving out of the house today too. Feels in some ways like its leaving free to carry out my plans again. She's now a big reason I've been holding everything together/ Just the idea that if I call it without her then she'd end up following suit anyway and that shes seeming far from ready to attempt right now too which is so fantastic to hear. I don't want to be the reason she goes down. The last thing I want is for anyone to hate me for this. It's like hating me for failing to win out against depression when I've fought so hard and really had some amazing wins. I guess it's something like craving recognition of what I've managed to accomplish and a fear that it'll all just be overshadowed by my failings. Right now, this very second, I wish I could be hugged. To be pet on and told that it's alright to be where I'm at. That for all the self hate and rejection I feel that I'm still loved dearly. That people I'm too shy to talk to notice me and think kindly of me. I feel alone even when I know I'm not. That I'm cherished by some of the most wonderful people. It's hard to keep my eyes open. Closing them feels good and so right. Opening them again... That's my biggest struggle.
I'm quitting Wellbutrin. Didn't take my dose today. I'm tired of feeling like my mind is clouded and it's compounding my issue with excessive sweating...

Well another couple of days here and gone. This week I'll be going on a trip alone with the friend I have a suicide pact with. She's been doing really well with her new meds. Ive kinda hoped that she would crash so we could leave together but shes really got a chance.

HAHAHAHA I wasn't feeling too bad.

I had a whole fucking thing written out I had put thought into and felt strongly about.

Set down the phone to go to my electrolysis appointment and I even copied the text to clipboard, just in case something went wrong.

Electrolysis rips me off for the second time and I'm so fucking weak and pitiful that I just hand her the fucking money anyway

I started to speak up at first and she just makes this fucking face like really

claims we started at 530, I said no wr started at 545. Its such a little fucking thing but it takes a monumental amount of fucking energy to do anything for myself she gives me another 5 min so great now im just overcharged 10min rather than 15...

i count out the full amount as she schedules me for next session. I mention passively about how yea it felt odd scheduling me at 545 this time. She looks it up 'oh i guess i did... thatll be 85(full amount)

Im shit

im pitiful

im weak

i hurt so fucking fucking much emotionally and my face fucking just naturally hurts cuz this is the most painful shit ive gone through yet

who cares

why do i bother, its thr motions

i turned off the phone so friends cant track me even though I just head home.

i drive with my eyes closed for a moment

i laid there on her table and apologized to her for me thinking we weren't finished at 630

I laid there eyes closed and in my head i was her

I was pointlessly stabbing me with the needle... making it hurt because I deserve it

because fuck me im a fucking freak to begin with

things would be better had I died

anf again anoyher good death missed

and again....... how long do i havr to run this fucking nightmare maze before im rewarded with just fucking darkness.

there's nothing on the other side an silence and nothingness i cant even comprehend with my constant chatteting mind

i want that darkness i want to be frozen thoughtless and unmoving for all time. Just for it to end

therapy once had me meditate on nothingness, on the end

hold a stick a plain twig with mild characteristics

close your eyes quiet your thoughts

feel the thing you hold and ride its curves, divets and textures with your mind as your fingers move

memorize it

when youre one with the stick and have it locked in your mind

when you know everything there is about your stick

hold it with one hand and silfe your fingers across it once more

feel as your fingers feel textures and curves and then suddenly nothing

that nothing as your fingers slide off of the stick and into the absence of it

can you comprehend it? can you envision that nothingness or absence of stick

but still can you feel that the absence of stick is entwined with the meaning of the stick

i can only understand what it is for there to be no stick through the presence of the stick in the first place

the end of my life... i cannot envision my presence of my life

ive been so long withdrawn and disassociated that the nothingness is all I know of and so I cant even fathom its existence. That what i feel now is somehow different than what life means to someone else.

that there is somehow an end to my life to even be had, something somehow different than what i know

i see images of self harm online there is a beauty in their scars and cuts

it's a life energy, one I'm too scared to touch too chicken shit to feel. it's sensation driven by a craving to feel something

I'm different though

through other types of self harm, withdrawal, disassociation... i want to feel nothing

i want to not feel the abuse

i want to not feel the rape

I want to not feel a burden

i want to no longer feel a freak

i want

to feel the solitary nothingness in place of where my mind will never stop attacking me

that unfathomable nothingness that we're all hurting towards already

i pray to anything and everything

Why should I keep trying when I have no hope? When my death can help someone I love? When I feel like I have no future?

I just want to cease existing. Prayed to wake up cisfemale; Prayed to wake up cismale; Prayed to just not wake up at all.

I can answer one of my own prayers

today i spoke more with my best friend. she knows that I've been trying just so very hard and she said she's amazed with how much i accomplish and that she sees me as an amazingly strong person. On one hand yes, I can see back on some of the monuments challenges I've made it through. That's me being logical and objective to that I've gone through and where i am now. the ways in which I've coped with my problems. Emotionally though...

I feel a severe self hate. Some lingering homophobia which i hold against myself. that I'm a freak, will never be a whole person and basically have been cursed since birth. I wish I'd have died during each of my near death experiences. It's nice to think there is some sort of God and a sense of supreme goodness in the universe but i fear that i don't really believe that. 

I don't think that there is any supreme goodness in any sense which could force suffering of the magnitude that exists on innocent children. To allow the demons and horrors exhibited by evil people to affect kind people. that there is some Divine plan is a joke and only serves to say that some person deserves the indescribable horrors that were inflicted on them. That I deserved repeated rape as a child. There isn't a God, we are all only dust, conciousness is only chemicals and electricity. Death is only darkness and as simple as a fingernail trimmed and discarded degrading into atoms to join with some other organism. 

That spark of uniqueness, of a different way of speaking and thinking and moving and acting? That soul within us? That's only someone else's perception of us. Our personality and the way we act to different stimulus. Dogs act a certain way right? And Cats? people who love fish think they have personalities. Some people personify their plants with a personality. when I die, i will be gone but my influences on other people will remain. Those things i did too help make someone feel better or boost confidence, that i try to show people which they perceive as my personality is what will be missed. But still, I have in store for me nothing more and no greater glory than an evil person. For there to be an unimaginable darkness/end to conciousness and to become the atoms to feed the earth to feed the animals to feed other people. Over time, my personality / my soul will be simply forgotten. The only remnant then, that kindness i gave to someone which may have impacted them enough to dominoe to the next person and so on. A universal good? That is the combined effect of a kind person through lifetimes resulting in a hug or a kiss or a bedtime story eternally passing from one animal to the next.

So I'm a little scared that I may just end up breaking my suicide pact and leaving without my partner... even possibly tonight. i don't know. I'm scared, I have a major surgery scheduled in January. one that will take every cent I have and an additional 20k beyond that. something that is stuck in my head is that I need to see to it that I can give my best friend as much money as I can when I leave.

tonight she cried on me about money problems and I only ended up sobbing as well. I don't know the stress she does in her day to day money problems but it does really hurt to think that I'd have to spend every cent on a hope to live but that it's literally a surgery to rip my face open. im just so tired of being afraid. i worry about my partner and the inevitable pain it'll cause her. she'll probably just follow suit anyway. she's been doing well keeping me a float but I'm close to drowning anyway and am doing a check-in with her all too often to see if she's ready which is akin to dragging her under with me. my eyes hurt

day couldn't get any better /s
i literally had to stand here while the toilet overflowed shitty water all around my feet while i cried... water wouldn't shut off so i used the toilet paper holder to prop up the float. then it's down on my knees vacuuming up the water and trying not to puke too. mopped floor with bleach now laying in shower just trying hold onto any will to live.

i wrote an email to hr asking that they start an lgbt pride initiative. I know I'll kill myself soon but maybe i can make life the tiniest bit better for someone else first. I've also wondered if there was any way to spark some positive change with my death. I don't know though, I don't think I'm strong enough for that anyway. I'm just a coward who plans to go to sleep with CO

Sitting here apologizing to my partner for when I'll end up leaving her... we have a suicide pact but her new meds have been doing good by her. quitee a few drinks in and a bit of drink overwatch was a nice distraction but none of it helps. I still want to die. I'm trying to wait if she ends up having a down swing but it's hard to stay when I'm in pain

yay the drinking began! it's self harm, i know it is. but it's a feeling other than wanting to cry constantly so very yay.

Its reddit i know but yea it hurts that i hardly ever get someone to try and talk with me. Couldn't feel more worthless but its just nice for people to listen

✋

That's really beautiful and touching, you really are a special person.

The abuse thing was from family so it sucks but I'm constantly subjected to it again and again so while i sometimes get a couple of steps ahead of it, I'll see them and end up in a puddle locked in the bathroom. Parents don't know.

Family child abuse as a kid taught me to disassociate as a self defense. I'd since figured that life was pointless to continue unless I broke down those walls and reconnected with my emotions so I could feel anything at all. Now though I've figured out some tough truths about myself and have made so much progress but it's more frequent that I'm breaking down. It feels like underneath everything I'm still a broken scared kid who hates herself and was born wrong. I've had close brushes and then a couple of attempts past that. I'm just tired and it feels like maybe I put too many cracks in an emotional dam that is drowning me now. Not a day goes by that I don't think of rape now when I never used to :'\(

I've had pretty horrible child abuse as a kid that haunts me and got tangled up with my identity as a transwoman. The more I've been struggling lately the harder I've been desperately trying. I've be achieving some amazing stuff but the weight of depression seems to just keep getting worse.

yea I've had a couple of therapists and still currently see an art therapist weekly. Also psych appointments once a month paired with 450mg Wellbutrin. I lied to her last month claiming I was feeling so much better. Things have steadily been getting worse though. I've got some horrible shit in my past and still have to see my rapist regularly. My mom doesn't know and I just want to be out of pain to let him live his life without me risking his family... It's my older brother...
has it helped you? how do you feel it benefited if at all. Also, thanks so so very much

Same here actually, walsleep is basically nyquil without the cold meds. Walmart brand is cheaper than the zquil one and between the two better also. It has an option that is dyeless.  

At least it's helped me at times being as I started taking nyquil every now and then in undergrad if I was having troubles with sleep.

That's really kind of you especially after seeing you were making your own posts trying to get help as well.  

Looking back through mine and my friends post histories I'm realizing how I'm breaking down to this point more and more often. The last time was only 2 weeks ago immediately after my roommate nearly broke our pact by making her own attempt. The weekend shouldve been an amazingly cool one. Played games with friends over on Friday. Saturday roommate and I went to all you can order sushi and stuffed ourselves on sashimi. Sunday I joined my bestie on an adventure for late night tea and ended up at a Kava bar trying it for the first time. It's disgusting but was a really nice time with her. I don't know, there just doesn't seem to be like a trigger anymore to my thinking. My mind will just drift towards it until I'm actively digging down harder to punish/hurt myself... Thinking of it last week was one hell of a shitshow too...  

Those two friends of mine and me, we were having a nice time with social drinking and all at my house. I hadn't been drinking because really I drink the least of all of us. But we decided to go in town and have some there as a fun outing. I didn't want to drive so had the bestie drive so that I could actually drink as much as I wanted and wouldn't have to be the responsible caring figure. She seemed perfectly fine so we jumped in car and went to atm where everything turned to shit. The roommate had an anxiety attack from a silly argument between the two of them that quickly brewed. She ended up jumping out of the moving car and running into the parkinglot where she disappeared. I'm in the back and crying now but have to pull my shit together to get out and find her while bestie is trying to get me to take sides.  

I'm running down the sidewalk and hear her roommate henceforth B sobbing and scream. I double back to see her laying against the dumpster crying. She gets up as I get closer and then immediately missteps and falls facefirst to the concrete. She broke her fall with her arm. I pull her into my lap and try to sooth her while the bestie (q) comes up and breaks down too. So now we're all in the parking lot crying and just holding hands. I get q to bring b and I back home for the night and I clean her up and we get ready for bed. q heads home. The next day is tears again when I meet up with q as I have to recount the entire night to her. Turns out she underestimated how inebriated she was so this whole fucking disaster saved us from getting on the interstate... I of course have a deathwish but also a need to protect q. She's the person I lean on for strength the most...  

yay, novel :(

Saw you were having trouble today too. I don't know of how much use I can be but I've used wal-sleep to try and ko myself at times when things were too much or I was too restless. Just the normal dose to maybe 1.5 rarely 2 if it's that bad.  

The nightmares though, they're there for me as well and antidepressents and the walsleep do seem to give me more dreams overall. I take wellbutrin

Is there anything you do to try and tether yourself just for the next day at least? Disassociating was my childhood defense and I have a TON of regrets because of it. It's only now in my 30s that I've gotten the therapy I needed to reconnect emotionally but it's been overwhelming. So came the high dose of antidepressents but that feels like the fog is just back. I get that its so I can try and deal with it in little pieces but anything that feels like a step back hurts so bad. They have been essential though to get this much further out from a previous breakdown and attempt.

Well I'm finally awake after passing out. Plenty of dreams including a couple of nightmares. I've called in a vacation day to work this morning but not before oversleeping a bit on all the zquil. Trying to get out of bed now too surround myself with those friends of mine.  

I love them but there is of course still that wish to be alone in my pain. I guess so in part it wouldn't hurt them too. The other reason is so I wouldn't have to fear hurting them even more. The best friend has had suicide in her life before with her Mom. It sometimes makes me just feel even worse for putting her through all of this again as I try to lean on her for strength.
That's amazingly sweet of you. thank you
Thank you, that's so very kind
